title: You get home late and the key is on the counter, behind the glass.

lines.text: Late at night you reach the front door, and the lock will not turn.
caps: Late at night you reach the front door,
and the lock will not turn.

lines.text: You pat every pocket in rising panic, and there it is, glinting on the counter behind the glass.
caps: You pat every pocket in rising panic,
and there it is, glinting on the counter,

lines.text: You slip inside, into a hallway where the shadows stretch longer than the hall.
caps: into a hallway where the shadows

lines.text: One floorboard creaks, and you freeze mid-step, listening.
At the glass door, cyan and magenta street neon slices across the room and blinds your reflection.
caps: At the glass door, cyan and magenta street neon

lines.text: You crouch-sprint past table and chair silhouettes toward the kitchen counter edge.
caps: You crouch-sprint past table and chair silhouettes,

lines.text: Your fingers close around the key, brass and finally real.
caps: Your fingers close around the key,

lines.text: You slide back to the door and turn the cylinder.
caps: You slide back to the door

lines.text: One clean click, and you step through into the night.
caps: and you step through into the night.
